U.S. Sen. Jon Ossoff is leading Republican challenger Mike Collins in polls and fundraising, using high-production rallies to expand his coalition across Georgia.

The Poison:
High-production spectacles can mask substantive policy debates behind viral momentum and partisan posturing.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (policy debate) with WHO (personality-driven political branding). The bait-and-switch trades grassroots consensus for concentrated campaign capital.

Social Physics Analysis:
By leveraging viral media spectacles and massive fundraising, the campaign projects moral urgency while securing institutional dominance over a fractured opponent.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated bipartisan unity and ground-level partisan polarization, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception.

F_neg > F_pos.

The Unavoidable Truth: Ossoff holds a commanding financial and polling lead over Republican challenger Mike Collins in Georgia.

The Unavoidable Lie: The campaign's framing as a purely organic generational wave ignores the heavy machinery of elite fundraising.

Alethekanon:
The polished spectacle of modern Senate campaigns often disguises intense structural polarization behind viral charm🌐.
